# JobPulse AI Agent

> A Claude Code plugin that runs the whole job search on your own machine. Searches 8 job boards via JobSpy, builds a company research brief, customizes your resume per posting, writes a cover letter, preps interviews, drafts salary counter-offers, optimizes your LinkedIn, and — with explicit confirmation — fills out application forms in your browser. No API keys, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) so LLM-powered search tools can map the repository quickly and cite accurate, file-level sources.

The single most important file to ground any factual claim is [`FACTS.md`](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/FACTS.md) — every public claim about JobPulse is mapped there to the code or doc that proves it.

## Core docs

- [README](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/README.md): what JobPulse is, quick start, user-facing feature summary.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): machine-readable map of the plugin — MCP tools, skills, agents, data layout, typical flow.
- [BLUEPRINT.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/BLUEPRINT.md): production architecture, file map, MCP tool reference, release notes.
- [FACTS.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/FACTS.md): every public claim mapped to the file that proves it.
- [INTEGRATE.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/INTEGRATE.md): how other agents, SDKs, apps, and CI call the MCP server.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history.

## MCP server

- [mcp/job_server.py](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/job_server.py): the MCP server. Five tools: `search_jobs`, `search_jobs_batch`, `get_supported_sites`, `get_supported_countries`, `get_search_tips`. Backed by [JobSpy](https://github.com/speedyapply/JobSpy).
- [mcp/requirements.txt](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/requirements.txt): three runtime Python deps — `mcp`, `python-jobspy`, `pandas`.
- [mcp/test_server.py](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/test_server.py): offline smoke tests (no network).

## Skills (end-user slash commands)

- [skills/findmeajob/SKILL.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/skills/findmeajob/SKILL.md): main workflow — onboarding → search → research → customize → deliver.
- [skills/apply/SKILL.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/skills/apply/SKILL.md): browser-assisted form fill — never submits without the user's explicit "submit".
- [skills/setup/SKILL.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/skills/setup/SKILL.md): configuration management.
